findings.title: Query q parameter filter implementation error
findings.detail: The q filter treats 'q' as a field name, causing KeyError. Need to implement q as OR search across title, author, isbn, synopsis ignoring case; also ensure multiple filters work correctly.

findings.title: ID path conversion error
findings.detail: GET /books/<id> uses int(path.split('/')[-1]) which raises ValueError if id is not an integer; returns 404 instead of 400 per spec.

findings.title: Filtering logic for multiple query parameters
findings.detail: The current implementation applies filters sequentially; should ensure all applied filters are satisfied (AND). This works in practice but could be clearer; minor clarity issue.
